title: SEG Test Specification Node
description: Schema for a TestSpecification node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Sourced from repo B (doxygen comment above test function + test function body). Authored by the Test Engineer. Discovered via @testcase doxygen tag.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this test specification. Form: {namespaceBase}/ts/TS-{number}.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. Maps to spdx:Artifact on SPDX export.

name.description: Human-readable test specification identifier. Must match the ID suffix in the id field.

description.description: The test intent as authored in the doxygen comment above the test function.

seg:sourceRepo.description: Source repository for this node. Fixed to repoB for all TestSpecification nodes.

seg:sourcePath.description: Relative path within repo B to the test file containing both the doxygen comment and the test function body.
